actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected complete portrait card. Image1 exact rejected full-resolution editing target; Image2 unchanged original small card controls actual PRIMARY IMAGE-LEFT three-quarter angle, hair, clothes, crop and light; Image3 mascot identity and compact rounded anatomy only. Correct ONLY elongated lower yellow face and collar contact. Current lower face hangs too far below closed mouth and tapers to a low angular point between collar corners. SHORTEN this lower segment substantially into a BROAD ROUNDED SHORT U base CLOSE BELOW mouth, making ONE COMPACT NEAR-ROUND yellow head. No long egg-shaped human jaw, tapered triangular chin, pointed V funnel or yellow throat shaft. Raise and broaden existing folded olive field collar around this shortened round base; keep actual shallow OPEN neckline and tiny dark central underlayer, coherent fabric overlap and contact shadow, minimal very short broad transition. Preserve EXACT original IMAGE-LEFT three-quarter view and roll, do not turn frontal to hide defect. Keep plain OLIVE/KHAKI compact soft field cap/low curved folded brim with NO gold badge or braid, no peaked officer or naval cap. Keep short BLACK forehead/temple hair, actual dark eyebrow HAIR, clean upper lip/chin and serious small CLOSED mouth, no grin/teeth. Retain OLIVE field garment, folded open pointed collar and tiny dark underlayer, NO Western white shirt/long tie/bow or embroidered stand collar. No hidden medals, pinched neckline, neck rolls, floating/clipping fabric or cream bib. Preserve complete tilted dark rim, OPAQUE DARK GREY photo backing and original lower-right cream note overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, genuine alpha only outside complete whole-card silhouette. Fine actual source details understated, no invented readable text.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
